answer: Attestation edges decay unless corroborated. When A witnesses B, the edge opens at full weight and halves each epoch nobody else independently witnesses both. A sybil ring cannot pass votes inside its own loop: that loop falls toward zero while the operator still pays registration and compute each round. To hold weight the cluster must push a vine outward into the honest graph and recruit real witnesses, graded too, whose standing falls if the vouching proves wrong. Each fake id becomes a lotus that must stay afloat on real output, and the attacker's voyage outward leaves a traceable trail.
